name: casual-game-platform
description: 피싱 셸을 수확한 TypeScript 모노레포 — 7종 캐쥬얼게임 양산 플랫폼

scripts.postinstall: patch-package --patch-dir games/fishngo/patches || echo '[postinstall] patch-package 없음 — 패치를 건너뜁니다(서버 전용 배포 등 게임 빌드가 없는 환경)'
scripts.build:all: npm run build:hub && npm run build:store && npm run build:eco01 && npm run build:bubblepong && npm run build:grillking && npm run build:sumoclash && npm run build:homerun && npm run build:dragonbeat && npm run build:archery && npm run build:zombiearrow && npm run build:duckhuntrush && npm run build:logistics && npm run build:soccerflick && npm run build:pathrush && npm run build:pawlink && npm run build:socialcasino && npm run build:flockgo && npm run build:solitaire && npm run build:fishing && npm run build:soccergo && npm run build:tictactoe && npm run build:kimbaproll
scripts.deploy:static: npm run build:all && npm run deploy:assemble
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/ttt-rules/tsconfig.json && tsc -p games/TICTACTOE/tsconfig.json && tsc -p services/api/tsconfig.json && tsc -p games/hub/tsconfig.json && tsc -p games/store/tsconfig.json && tsc -p games/eco01/tsconfig.json && tsc -p games/bubblepong/tsconfig.json && tsc -p games/Grillking/tsconfig.json && tsc -p games/SumoClash/tsconfig.json && tsc -p games/Homerun/tsconfig.json && tsc -p games/DragonBeat/tsconfig.json && tsc -p games/Archery/tsconfig.json && tsc -p games/ZombieArrow/tsconfig.json && tsc -p games/DuckhuntRush/tsconfig.json && tsc -p games/Logistics/tsconfig.json && tsc -p games/SoccerFlick/tsconfig.json && tsc -p games/PathRush/tsconfig.json && tsc -p games/PawLink/tsconfig.json && tsc -p games/Pickmeup/tsconfig.json && tsc -p games/SocialCasino/tsconfig.json && tsc -p games/FlockGo/tsconfig.json && tsc -p games/Solitare/tsconfig.json
scripts.deploy:tictactoe:msstore: npm run build:tictactoe:msstore && npm run assemble:tictactoe:msstore
